quote: You can't print that close to the edge of the bed on a plate that hasn't been seasoned properly first. The job has been stopped. The bed is clear. Mark two is available for you to try again. You just need to stay away from the edges of the bed. I think we try to get things at least 20 millimeters in, if not 80 millimeters in. It really depends on what you're printing, though. There should be some guidance in the repo about this already. In any case, please start a new print closer together.
